title: 第17章 恒宇遭劫叶凡修行西皇帝路第18章 俘获太阴圣女聊天群的名字来源
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
【——相信你一定会成为一代女帝的！】
人皇庙内。
少女微微一怔。
她抬眸看向眼前的人皇法相，隐约间仿佛看见人皇在朝着自己微笑，那充满神性且看不清容貌的法相，在这一刻莫名多了些许温柔……
“人皇！”
萧盈华有些激动。
她的俏脸红扑扑的：“我一定不会让您失望的！”
这一刻。
少女的心中充满坚定。
她对于帝路的争锋已经势在必得。
哪怕没有大成圣体护道？哪怕师门长辈对她充满了质疑？她依旧没有任何的气馁！
我自飞扬临天下！
史上少有女子证道，不代表她不能证道；古今未有道胎成帝，不代表她不能成帝！
今后。
她势必会以己身之力。
一举打破世人的偏见与质疑。
想至此处。
少女微微转身。
她在人皇法相的注视下。
坚定的的走出了这一座庙宇。

其实在她踏出人皇庙的那一刻。
帝路便已经出现在了她的脚下，她接下来所走的每一步，都将会成为她登临绝巅的过程，每一个脚印都将会成为她铸就无上根基的底蕴！
随着‘奔驰大帝’被权限狗再一次禁言制裁。
聊天群便渐渐冷清了下来。
姜恒宇似乎也开始将重心放到了修行上面，前不久萧盈华那一句‘恒宇大帝’给他到来了不小的触动，虽说他觉得一切都是巧合……
但，
万一呢？
万一他就是那位恒宇大帝呢？
随着聊天群逐渐冷清。
林昭也开始了新一轮的修行。
他这一世已经将战力推至了巅峰，一举在天帝领域中站稳了跟脚，几乎进无可进。
除非进行蜕变。
活出新生。
不然。
他的战力很难在发生变化了，毕竟他实在是太强了，已经在这一世达到了当前的极限。
“蜕变的事情暂时不急。”
林昭心中想道。
他对于自身的蜕变已经制定了一个明确的计划，他主修混沌大道，这一道包罗万象、熔炼百经，他完全可以一世修行一道，最后九道合一，分化万道，成就真正的混沌无极。
到了这种程度。
已经没有什么先天混沌与后天混沌的区分了。

毕竟。
大道哪有先天后天？
content_en:
[——I believe you will definitely become a generational empress! 】
Inside the Renhuang Temple.
The girl was slightly startled.
She raised her eyes to look at the Human Emperor's Faxiang in front of her, and vaguely seemed to see the Human Emperor smiling at her. The Faxiang, which was full of divinity and whose appearance could not be seen clearly, was inexplicably a little more gentle at this moment...
"Human Emperor!"
Xiao Yinghua was a little excited.
Her pretty face turned red: "I won't let you down!"
This moment.
The girl's heart was filled with determination.
She is determined to win the battle for the Imperial Road.
Even without the Dacheng Holy Body to protect the Tao? Even if the elders of the division are full of doubts about her? She is still not discouraged at all!
I am soaring to the world!
There are very few women in history who have attained enlightenment, which does not mean that she cannot attain enlightenment; there has never been a Taoist fetus in history who has become an emperor, but it does not mean that she cannot become an emperor!
from now on.
She will definitely use her own strength.
Breaking the world's prejudices and doubts in one fell swoop.
Think about this.
The girl turned slightly.
She was under the gaze of the Human Emperor.
He walked out of this temple firmly.
In fact, the moment she stepped out of the Human Emperor Temple.
The Imperial Road has already appeared at her feet. Every step she takes next will be her journey to the top, and every footprint will become the foundation for her to build a supreme foundation!
As the ‘Mercedes-Benz Emperor’ was once again banned and sanctioned by the authority dog.
The chat group gradually became deserted.
Jiang Hengyu seems to have begun to focus on practice. Not long ago, Xiao Yinghua's words "Emperor Hengyu" touched him a lot, although he thought everything was a coincidence...
But,
What if?
What if he is the Great Emperor Hengyu?
As the chat group gradually became deserted.
Lin Zhao also started a new round of practice.
He has pushed his combat power to its peak in this life, and has established a firm foothold in the Heavenly Emperor's realm, with almost no way forward.
Unless there is a transformation.
Live a new life.
otherwise.
It is difficult for his combat power to change. After all, he is too strong and has reached his current limit in this life.
"The matter of transformation is not urgent for the time being."
Lin Zhao thought in his mind.
He has made a clear plan for his own transformation. He majors in the Avenue of Chaos, which is all-encompassing and smelting hundreds of scriptures. He can practice one path in a lifetime, and finally the nine paths will merge into one, divide ten thousand paths, and achieve the true Chaos Wuji.
To this extent.
There is no longer any distinction between innate chaos and acquired chaos.
after all.
How can the great road be innate and nurtured?
